g.text: qwen3-asr: precision ladder (8bit best on the 1.7B, 0.6B steeper)
20-file corpus, 15s window; 8bit is the default on both sizes. A rung replaces 8bit only if its paired CI lies wholly above zero: on the 1.7B, 4bit, 6bit and bf16 lie below it (8bit
wins) and 5bit spans it; on the 0.6B, 4bit and 5bit lie below it and 6bit and bf16 span it (a tie keeps the default). Source: qwen3-asr.md.
